items.headline:
China is seeing a historic boom in exports due to AI.

China’s exports rose +25% YoY in August, their 3rd-largest monthly reading in at least 2 years.

At the same time, imports surged +28%, pushing the monthly trade surplus to +$119 billion and the year-to-date surplus to +$806

BREAKING: South Korea's exports surged +78.3% YoY in the first 20 days of September, its strongest monthly growth on record.

This brought the value of exports to $71.4 billion, an all-time high.

This also marks the 5th consecutive month with growth of at least +50.0%.
